explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 61 named tracks, releases and catalogue cuts across current September electronic pages, Maxime Denuc's September 11 programmed-organ album, D1's September 11 Tempa archive, adjacent Hiss Is Bliss/ODAE/Light-years/Tempa material, current Boomkat and Bandcamp Daily pages, and overlooked early-2000s dubstep catalogue links. Official and attributed written evidence only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 181's Picture, Akufen and Marco Maldarella field and Runs 170–180 were not recycled; failed requests and process repairs supplied no reusable musical verdicts.
Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior discovery leads and exact tracks already in the global utility ledger were excluded.
Nine honest exact-title leads survived without artist, texture or genre quotas. Every proposed URI pair was re-derived from the current 49-track ledger and checked for adjacency and prose agreement.

Maxime Denuc's six leads rank first because the official release notes describe individual construction. Three D1 archive identities remain lower-ranked catalogue leads because the official Tempa page confirms exact identity and 2002–2006 provenance while detailed structure is attributed rather than auditioned.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
sourceWindows: CURRENT STRUCTURAL-FREEDOM WINDOW: Maxime Denuc's Club Imperiale, released September 11, 2026, uses a hand-built Max/MSP/OSC system to control pipe-organ keys, stops and pedals, reworking trance, techno, church acoustics and historical reference. https://maximedenuc.bandcamp.com/album/club-imperiale

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / CURRENT ARCHIVE WINDOW: D1's Tempa Archive, Vol 2: Enigma, issued September 11, 2026, makes eight 2002–2006 dubs available as exact identities. https://d1london.bandcamp.com/album/tempa-archive-vol-2-enigma-ep

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: current Light-years, Tempa, Hiss Is Bliss, ODAE, Boomkat, Bandcamp Daily and Resident Advisor pages were inspected; recent handled Ploy, Bonobo, Blawan, Jay Mitta, Lil_art_hoe, Picture, Akufen and Marco Maldarella identities were excluded.
